_comment: Streetmondex text per species (presentation only). Numbers such as stats, height and weight come from creatures.json. Every species needs an entry; Data validation checks it.

lore: Strapback hang around corner stores after dark, eyes glowing orange under their hoods.
They tape anything metal to themselves. Nobody knows where they get the tape.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, at dusk and at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: Holster stand with their hands near their hips, always ready to draw first.
Some say the pouches hold spare magazines; others say snacks.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: The latch on Hardcase's chest has never been seen open.
Gangs bring a Hardcase to a deal so everyone keeps their hands where they can be seen.

habitatHints.text: Only by evolving Holster

lore: Slugger's shoulder cylinders click round as it sniffs out trouble.
A Slugger on a leash is the classic patrol partner for night-shift officers.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, at night (strays turn up in Downtown and the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: Longshot stand on one leg on the piers for hours, watching the water through a scope eye.
It never misses twice. Usually it doesn't need to.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, by day and at dusk (strays turn up in the Park)

lore: Overwatch plant their tripod legs on roof edges and watch whole blocks at a time.
Pigeons won't land within ten metres of one.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, by day and at dusk

lore: A stack of cinder blocks that got up and walked off a building site.
Cinderblock rebuild themselves with whatever bricks are lying around.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Uptown, by day, at dusk and at night (strays turn up in Midtown)

lore: Traffic rumbles across Overpass's back in its sleep.
Commuters swear the BQE was shorter before one moved in underneath.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, at night

lore: Curbstone curl into balls at the side of the road and wait to trip someone up.
Street sweepers give them a wide berth.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Uptown, by day and at dusk

lore: Rebarb bristle with steel rods and fire them when cornered.
Building sites post signs warning about them. Nobody reads the signs.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, by day, at dusk and at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: Doubleshift run their routes before dawn, the clock on their belly ticking fast.
They evolve if they keep levelling through the small hours.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Midtown, by day and at dusk (strays turn up in Uptown)

lore: Overtime has a clock on each side and has never once clocked out.
It gets stronger the longer the fight goes on.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Midtown, at night

lore: Hustlepup haul backpacks twice their size between offices all day.
Tip one and it will remember you for life.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, by day and at dusk (strays turn up in Uptown)

lore: Cashew stuff their cheeks with coins from park fountains.
It never spends them. Nobody knows where the stash is.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, by day and at dusk

lore: Exhaustfume drift out of tailpipes in traffic jams and hang at ankle height.
Breathing one in makes your eyes water for an hour.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, by day, at dusk and at night (strays turn up in Midtown)

lore: Backfire's pipes go off like gunshots, which drives Gun types wild.
Car alarms go off when one walks past.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: A see-through fox with three ring-tipped tails, gone the moment you look straight at it.
Park rangers only know one is near from the smell of incense.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, at dusk and at night

lore: Flue warm themselves on rooftop chimneys and puff soot rings when content.
Old brownstones with a Flue in the chimney never need heating.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Uptown, at night

lore: Subsonic's cone thumps so low you feel it before you hear it.
It evolves if it levels up near the clubs at night.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Midtown, at night (strays turn up in Downtown)

lore: Three cones and a ring on its back: windows rattle a block away when Woofer barks.
Block parties used to rent one. Then the neighbours complained.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: Streetlamp hum at mains frequency and gather under bridges after dusk.
Lost walkers follow their glow home. Usually.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, at dusk and at night (strays turn up in Uptown)

lore: Wirewhip hang from stubs of power line, crackling.
Linemen check for one before they climb.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park

lore: Rooftail gather on antennas before storms; the static makes their feathers stand up.
Couriers say a flock overhead means the signal is about to drop.

habitatHints.text: Rooftops in every district, by day and dusk

lore: Antennaroc only land on the highest aerial in sight, and the whole block's TVs go to snow.
Its chest speaker plays whatever station it last flew through.

habitatHints.text: High rooftops in Midtown and Downtown, at dusk (or evolve Rooftail)

lore: Neonmoth circle bar signs all night and buzz when they're nervous.
A flickering sign usually means one is sleeping inside.

habitatHints.text: Rooftops in Midtown and Downtown, at dusk and at night

lore: Marqueen's wings are theatre marquees, every bulb lit.
Evolves from a Neonmoth that levels up at night.

habitatHints.text: Downtown rooftops at night (or evolve Neonmoth at night)

lore: Dishling turn their shells to follow the strongest signal, a few degrees an hour.
Building supers find them wedged behind the water tank.

habitatHints.text: Rooftops in Uptown and Midtown, any time

lore: A concrete broadcast tower on legs; its aviation light blinks in time with its heartbeat.
Pirate radio DJs follow it from roof to roof.

habitatHints.text: Uptown rooftops at night (or evolve Dishling)

lore: Gutterat travel in packs and pass messages by tapping on pipes.
Leave out a crust and a Gutterat will trade you a bottle cap for it.

habitatHints.text: Sewers under every district, any time

lore: Its crown is made of bottle caps paid as tribute by its court.
Evolves from a Gutterat at Lv 22; wild ones rule the Downtown sewers at night.

habitatHints.text: Downtown sewers at night (or evolve Gutterat)

lore: Every Drainling started as someone's pet. They don't hold a grudge, mostly.
They like the fast channels and drift along with the current.

habitatHints.text: Midtown and Downtown sewers, near the channels

lore: Concrete has grown into its hide, plate by plate.
Maintenance crews leave a sandwich at the grate as a toll.

habitatHints.text: Midtown sewers at night (or evolve Drainling)

lore: A cluster of mushrooms that learned to shuffle.
It puffs spores when startled; they make you sneeze for an hour.

habitatHints.text: Dead ends and chambers under Uptown and Midtown

lore: Moldmother carpets whole chambers and glows a soft green in the dark.
Tunnel dwellers say the air near it tastes like rain.

habitatHints.text: Uptown sewer chambers at night (or evolve Mildew)

lore: Gridlock surfaces when the whole city is stuck at once. Nobody agrees whether it causes the jams or feeds on them.
Trainers say if you hear every car alarm on a block go off together, run towards it, not away.

habitatHints.text: Rampages through Midtown or Downtown traffic, very rarely (a raid)

lore: Blackout drifts down avenues at night and drinks every light it passes.
When it's gone the street lamps come back on all at once, brighter than before.

habitatHints.text: Uptown or Midtown streets at night, very rarely (a raid)

lore: The sewer crews hum when they work so it knows they're friends. Nobody has ever said what happens if you don't.
It sleeps under the oldest chamber in the tunnels. Something has to wake it.

habitatHints.text: Deep in the Midtown sewer, once the sewer community asks for help (a quest)

lore: Curbcrusher shoves parked cars back onto the road if they so much as touch its kerb.
Its hazard stripes are painted on. Nobody knows who keeps repainting them.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Uptown, by day and at dusk, or evolve Curbstone (Lv 24)

lore: Jackpot's belly reels spin when it's excited. Three cherries means it's about to bite.
It hoards coins in Park tree hollows, and Park rangers find them by the bucket.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, by day and at dusk, or evolve Cashew (Lv 22)

lore: Fogbank rolls over the Park lake at night with a warm light glowing somewhere inside.
Lost joggers who follow the light always seem to end up at the gate nearest home.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, at night, or evolve Hazeling (Lv 28)

lore: Floodlight turns the Park bright as day when it flares its four lamps.
Every moth in the city flies to it, and so do half the night's Streetmon.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, at night, or evolve Streetlamp (Lv 26)

lore: Barricade plants itself across a street and dares anything on wheels to try.
Downtown crews rent it by the night. The police have tried to impound it three times.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Downtown, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park, or evolve Rebarb (Lv 30)

lore: Bigshot's bat is two shotgun barrels taped together, and it has never missed a swing.
Waterfront loan sharks keep one around. The interest rates go up when it's in the room.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park, or evolve Slugger (Lv 30)

lore: Smokestack wandered off when its factory closed and never let its fire go out.
On cold Uptown nights the homeless sleep in its shadow for the warmth.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Uptown, at night, or evolve Flue (Lv 32)

lore: Livewire is a downed power line that refused to stay down.
It hums one low note, and the street lights flicker in time.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, at night (strays turn up in the Park). Only dangerous in the Park, or evolve Wirewhip (Lv 33)

lore: Hustlehound has never delivered a package late, and has never used the front door.
Its goggles are pushed up because it doesn't need them; it just likes the look.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Park, by day and at dusk (strays turn up in Uptown), or evolve Hustlepup (Lv 22)

lore: Tagling tags every wall it passes and its paint never quite dries.
Midtown building owners chase it with buckets. It always gets away, dripping.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Midtown, by day and at dusk

lore: Muralist paints a whole wall overnight and signs it with a glowing halo.
Galleries have tried to buy its murals. It only paints on walls that aren't for sale.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: Midtown, at night, or evolve Tagling (Lv 25)

lore: Bollard wandered up the pier one day. Ships still try to tie up to it.
It is almost impossible to push over. Waterfront kids dare each other to try.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, by day and at dusk

lore: Gullgrifter runs a chip racket on the pier in a stolen flat cap.
It has never paid for anything and has never missed a dropped fry.

habitatHints.text: Home turf: the Waterfront, by day and at dusk

lore: Clogger is everything anyone ever flushed, packed hard enough to walk.
Sewer crews have pulled a wedding ring, three phones and a set of car keys out of one.

habitatHints.text: Sewers under Uptown and Midtown, by day, at dusk and at night
